findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: zola_get_vendor_details, zola_get_support_options · Private data: zola_get_support_options · Public sink: zola_get_support_options · Destructive: zola_get_planning_timeline_template.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: zola_get_vendor_details, zola_get_support_options · Private data: zola_get_support_options · Public sink: zola_get_support_options · Destructive: zola_get_planning_timeline_template

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
